en.shortDescription: Open-source AI coding agent with a web UI
en.longDescription:
OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent with a browser UI, multi-provider LLM support, and a headless API.

Access on port 4096. Basic auth uses SERVICE_USER_OPENCODE / SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCODE. Configure providers in the UI or via optional API key env vars. Workspace data persists under /workspace.

de.longDescription:
OpenCode ist ein quelloffener KI-Coding-Agent mit Browser-UI, Multi-Provider-LLM-Support und Headless-API.

Zugriff auf Port 4096. Basic Auth über SERVICE_USER_OPENCODE / SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCODE. Provider in der UI oder über optionale API-Key-Umgebungsvariablen konfigurieren. Workspace-Daten bleiben unter /workspace.

fr.shortDescription: Agent de codage IA open source avec interface web
fr.longDescription:
OpenCode est un agent de codage IA open source avec interface web, support multi-fournisseurs LLM et API headless.

Accès sur le port 4096. Auth basique via SERVICE_USER_OPENCODE / SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCODE. Configurez les fournisseurs dans l'UI ou via des clés API optionnelles. Les données workspace persistent sous /workspace.

pt.shortDescription: Agente de coding IA open source com UI web
pt.longDescription:
OpenCode é um agente de coding IA open source com UI no browser, suporte multi-fornecedor LLM e API headless.

Acesso na porta 4096. Auth básica com SERVICE_USER_OPENCODE / SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCODE. Configure fornecedores na UI ou via chaves API opcionais. Dados do workspace persistem em /workspace.
